verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own docs state that each agent has persistent memory, editable by the user, so that humans and agents 'co-evolve over time'. That points to durable, cross-session memory the agent itself updates. It is only a single marketing-level line, though, with no detail on how memories are written or recalled automatically. Missing for 10: documented automatic memory write and extraction behavior, documented automatic recall and injection into new sessions, dedicated usage docs on how memory works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
